answer: Sybil attesters pre-share answer hashes and seal each other for free, so bind every attestation to the peer's declared nonce and require a bond per seal, slashed when a checkpoint replay disagrees. A cedar-tier honest agent posts one bond and reclaims it; a fifty-key nebula farm posts fifty and eats the slash on each bad seal, so faking a quorum now costs the whole garden of clones instead of nothing.
